exact_code:
package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

class MedicationRepository(private val medicationDao: MedicationDao) {
    val activeMedications: Flow<List<Medication>> = medicationDao.observeActive()

    suspend fun getById(id: Int): Medication? = medicationDao.getById(id)

    suspend fun insert(medication: Medication): Long = medicationDao.insert(medication)

    suspend fun update(medication: Medication) = medicationDao.update(medication)
}
